mechanism.claim: Positive minute-to-minute memory in completed trade-arrival counts identifies persistent execution intensity rather than a one-off activity burst. When that memory enters its upper tail during elevated realized variation, persistent participation should carry the completed displacement for eight hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of the completed eight-hour BTC return
mechanism.why_distinct: Trade-arrival backloading uses the final-hour share; directional trade breadth allocates counts by return sign; ticket candidates use volume per trade; price serial-autocorrelation candidates ignore executions. HVTAMC uses only lag-one serial dependence of minute execution counts for eligibility and reuses no prior event set or control.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: three daily onsets from execution-count memory are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_window: 480 exact coherent bars_binance BTCUSDT interval=1m rows [D-8h,D)
features.trade_counts: finite nonnegative integer number_of_trades on every minute; strict positive block total and nonconstant lag vectors
features.arrival_memory: Pearson correlation between number_of_trades[0:479] and number_of_trades[1:480], finite in [-1,1]
features.memory_rank: strict-prior midrank of arrival_memory over at most 270 earlier source-valid blocks, minimum 180; current excluded; rank>=0.75
features.realized_variation: sum squared log(close/open) over 480 one-minute rows, finite strict positive
features.completed_return: log(last close/first open), finite strict nonzero
features.onset: eligible now and immediately previous exact source-valid block ineligible

clock.decision: D after the full path completes
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal entry
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact realized funding only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent serial dependence of completed minute execution counts

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no window, memory functional, rank, onset, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, or control repair
